reason: A DSH plugin for recalling relevant excerpts and metadata from persisted past sessions through full-text search, supporting cross-session model context.

summaries.zh: 通过全文检索当前 DSH_HOME 中的历史会话，为模型和用户返回相关片段及会话信息。
summaries.en: Searches persisted sessions in the current DSH_HOME and returns relevant excerpts and session metadata for cross-session recall.

capabilities: Full-text searches persisted sessions in the current DSH_HOME through ctx.sessionQuery
Returns matching session metadata and highlighted excerpts to the current context
Provides a model tool named recall and a /recall human command
